title: Building elevation: assessment rubric
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 1: Architecture: Hundertwasser and Zaha Hadid
intro: Lesson 18: Designing a building: elevation; assessed piece. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Criterion
Working towards
Secure
Excellent
rows: Shape roughly drawn; scale not used
Main shapes to scale with a ruler
All parts to scale, neat and measured
Three annotations link form to function
Annotations explain clearly how each feature serves the building's users
One influence used (Islamic architecture, Hundertwasser or Hadid)
Influences combined with purpose and explained
Polished, with a clear title and careful colour

head: Requirement
Detail
rows: A community building of your choice
Front elevation, rough scale 1 cm : 1 m
At least one: Islamic architecture, Hundertwasser or Hadid

keywords.def: a flat drawing of one side of a building
drawing smaller in proportion, such as 1 cm to 1 m

questions.q: At 1 cm : 1 m, how tall is a 12 m building on paper?
Draw and annotate your building elevation to the brief; photograph and upload with a two-sentence explanation.
questions.a: An accurate, annotated elevation meeting the brief.

questions.q: Extend: add a small plan view (from above).
